full_details: At the Theatre in the morning you put the finished book into Abel Garnish's hands. He made one woman of the Wife, the Mother, and the Lady. The man with the Nurse's fan is written as Kemp, and the roll will carry his own name, because he would like it. You gave Heminges the count and no new tally. Twenty-odd parts, and three boys. Garnish called the two hours a lie and made it three, and you told him a sonnet is allowed one. The company did not read the play. The rolls are not out. The fee was not this morning's line. At two you were Gaunt. The Rose had the first Tamburlaine. You did not cross. The old line about the king was still on your tables at home. The three cut leaves stayed in Garnish's chest. They felt warm in the hand. That is a feeling, and not a scene.
one_sentence: You gave Garnish fifty clean leaves, played Gaunt with the first Tamburlaine in your ear, and the three cut leaves stayed in his chest.
title: Fifty leaves, and Gaunt
